result_summary.title: SSO Integration Module: MFA prompt missing for EU-West users
result_summary.description: A critical issue has been identified with the SSO Integration Module in the EU-West production environment. The MFA prompt is not appearing for users during login. This is affecting nearly 1,000 users and has a high business impact. We believe the SSO configuration is incorrectly bypassing the MFA step. Please fix the prompt visibility immediately.
